description: Learning-curve tier N = 400: the character-level BIO tagger of configs/train_v2.json with the same backbone, hyperparameters, epochs, evaluation schedule, patience and checkpoint rule (none tuned, none changed per tier), trained on setting S3 of weak build 20261003-weak_lc400 (training chapters 1-400 minus the dev chapters; the dictionary and the Opus lists truncated at 400 as that build's record states: a dictionary row without a reveal chapter is dated by the first chapter up to 780 whose Opus list names it and dropped when that is after 400; strict except the stated residual of such rows that no list up to 780 names, which are dated only by a substring test on the training texts). The setting is fixed to S3 by the train_v2 selection rule (highest mean dev micro F1 over seeds 1-3), decided before any tier was trained; seeds 1, 2, 3. Inside a run the checkpoint is the one with the best strict micro F1 on dev answers v2 (the 31 answered dev chapters, which reach chapter 777; ties: the earlier step): a stated deviation from a pure cold start, since a new book would have no answered chapters after 400. max_epochs stays 6 as in train_v2, so a small tier takes few optimizer steps; nothing compensates for the smaller data. Label versions: this tier trains only on extract_v1 lists. Nothing about a tier is chosen on the test set.
